description: The DNS API answers a certificate call for a DNS zone that does not exist with a 403 `{"message":"domain not found"}` (or `subdomain not found` for the list), not the `not_found` envelope. Observed 2026-10-21 in the live Project: `GET` and `DELETE /domain/v2beta1/ssl-certificates/{dns_zone}` for a zone that was never created, or whose zone was deleted, answered 403 `domain not found`, and `GET /domain/v2beta1/ssl-certificates?dns_zone=...` answered 403 `subdomain not found`. Without its zone there is no certificate, so the error is typed here as not found (`httpError` 404) for a caller to tell an absent certificate from a refused call; the wire status is 403.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The DNS zone the certificate is for does not exist.
